findings_resolved.resolution: Implemented binary compute_merkle_root algorithm and wired into /api/sessions/ledger/blocks and /api/sessions/ledger/verify.
Enforced SSRF destination domain allowlist (ALLOWED_ML_DOMAINS) in app/remote_ml.py before any outbound HTTP dispatch.
Added canonical Blueprint route aliases for GET /api/sessions/open, GET /api/reports/{id}, GET /api/ledger/blocks, GET /api/ledger/verify, GET /api/ledger/cert/65b/{id}, POST /api/ledger/anchor.
